description: Links between accounts and pseudonymous identifiers. Both columns are foreign keys: load accounts.valid.json first, and create entities ENT-V-01 through ENT-V-03 via /api/v1/ingestion/entities before posting this (there is no entities fixture file, because an entity record is three fields and inventing it in the test is clearer than a file to cross-reference). The last record uses a source system's wording rather than the canonical values, so the alias path is covered here and not only described.

metadata_json.note: Deterministic: the identifier came from the account record itself. No confidence, because certainty about an exact match is a different kind of thing from a probability and showing it as 1.000 invites comparison with 0.94.
The same device on a second account. A real signal and a weak one: shared handsets and recycled numbers produce exactly this, and co-occurrence is not common control.
Inferred after normalisation, so it carries a confidence and a review state.
Time-bounded rather than deleted. A link that was true last year is still a fact about last year, and a point-in-time query must see it as it stood.

Written in a source system's own words rather than the platform's. HEURISTIC normalizes to NORMALIZED and PENDING to NEEDS_REVIEW, so this record exercises the alias path: a real feed will not use our vocabulary, and the ones that map onto it honestly are accepted rather than refused. Values with no honest destination -- a product type where a holder type belongs, an enforcement state -- are refused instead, and those cases live in the invalid fixture.
